title: encyclia domingensis
intro: Encyclia domingensis, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night", is a species of orchid native to the Dominican Republic. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Encyclia domingensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and modulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
